Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Court No. - 87 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 5257 of 2023 Applicant :- Abid Khan Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 5257 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Shivendra Raj Singhal,Rishika Raj Singhal Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Supplementary affidavit, filed today, is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant; learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 38 of 2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station-Armapur, District-Kanpur Nagar, during pendency of trial.
It is alleged in the F.I.R. that while selection in Agniveer, the applicant impersonated himself as Aakash and appeared in physical examination but on biometric verification found forged person.
Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.

He has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged by the Abid Khan vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109230667/
1 prosecution.

entities.text: Abid Khan vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The involvement of the applicant in the present case is without any evidence.
During verification, applicant was apprehended and was not appointed or approved in the recruitment.
Applicant has not prepared any false documents nor got benefit on verge of documents.
The applicant has no criminal history.
Moreover, there is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 10.11.2022 and in case, he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Abid Khan, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 Meenu Singh  Abid Khan vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109230667/
